name: Roland AX-Edge
description: Roland AX-Edge keytar: the temporary program (common, effects, arpeggio, vocoder, and the part, EQ and zone blocks of all five parts) with part 1's Z-Core tone. From the temporary (edit-buffer) area of the MIDI Implementation.

sources.title: AX-Edge MIDI Implementation (version 1.01, Jul 1, 2020)
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from AX-Edge_MIDI_Imple_eng02_W.pdf (sha256 c728df8af34fdf4801314ead8a535069c4923de6dcf3c05a0f5d365e9fee075a). Model ID 00 00 00 52, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Program-level blocks for all five parts (Part, EQ, Zone); part 1's tone at 01 01 00 00. Parts 2-5 play tones at 01 03 00 00, 01 05 00 00, 01 07 00 00 and 01 09 00 00, the same table, not laid out.
Program MFX (03)-(05) are left out: the manual's [Program] table (p6) prints the third row as "00 37 00 Program MFX (04)", off the 02 00 stride of the first two.
The program name is printed as "NAME 1" to "NAME 16" (p8), so it is sixteen ASCII parameters here rather than one text field. A tone's name is printed as sixteen rows of "Name" (p14).

p13-14: [Partial Filter Env] ends with a "Pitch Env Velocity Curve" row (00 2C, Total Size 2D) and [Partial Pitch Env] is 2C long; the FANTOM-6/7/8 manual has that row at the end of the pitch envelope instead. Kept as printed.

coverage.inboundControllers: not modelled: what the front panel transmits (CC, RPN) is not in the address map
coverage.partTones: part 1 only: the tones of parts 2-5 are the same [Tone] table at 01 03 00 00, 01 05 00 00, 01 07 00 00 and 01 09 00 00, and are not laid out
coverage.programMfx: parts 1 and 2 only: p6 prints the Program MFX list as (01) 00 30 00, (02) 00 32 00, :, (04) 00 37 00, which does not add up, so (03) to (05) are left out rather than guessed
coverage.editor: not laid out: the Editor area (0F 00 00 00, [Edit]) has no table in the manual
coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: MFX/IFX, chorus and reverb parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on the selected type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list
